text:
mira: Quick ask — we need a compact benchmark tile pack + webinar hero set for next week's launch. Core priorities: clear latency/cost sparkline, 1x social tile, 2x hero headers, figma components, and a 'how it routes leads' mini flow. Deadline EOD Thursday. Can design pick this up?

leo_marketing: Yep — can do. What's the final asset list and sizes? social: 1080x1080, hero: 1200x628? Also need copy variants for A/B.

toni_design: Happy to take. Can we standardize on these sizes and a single figma file with components? I'll create tokens for sparklines and dot points.

toni_design: Draft spec:
```
- files: figma (pages: tiles, hero, webinar)
- components: tile/base, sparkline, CTA, badge
- outputs: 1080x1080 PNG, 1200x628 PNG, 1920x1080 webinar hero
- color tokens: --redwood-ink, --redwood-ink-60, --accent-green
- accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast on body copy
```

mira: Perfect. Also need a condensed one-pager for sales with routing diagram (PNG + PDF). Sam, can you confirm routing steps and UTMs?

sam_sales: Routing: inbound forms -> SFDC lead creation -> enrichment -> routing rules -> SDR queue. Please include 3 AB tests: fast-path, batch-queue, fallback-model. UTMs: ?utm_source=benchmark&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch1

toni_design: Will mock the routing as a simplified swimlane diagram. Any legal copy checks?

amanda_legal: Flag: don't call out specific competitor names or price claims. Also need to add standard privacy footer for lead capture screenshots. I'll review final art by Tues.

mira: Noted. Also requires localization-ready layers for de/pt/es later. Toni, can you include copy variants in separate text layer? 

toni_design: Yes. I'll include a copy layer and tokens for translations. Also adding alt-text notes in figma.

mira: One more — please follow brand guardrails: logo clearspace, no drop shadows, and our type scale. See https://redwood.com/brand/guardrails (link)

toni_design: Uploading first pass to figma in #design-assets by Wed noon. Will leave comments for copy and sales.

ops_bot: Reminder: marketing assets must pass final compliance check before publish. Use /asset-check tag in #marketing when ready. :robot_face:

mira: Thanks team. If design runs into scope creep ping me. I'll consolidate copy and coordinate legal review.
